sql: SELECT id, status, total_cents FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = 42 LIMIT 1
SELECT name, country FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = 7 LIMIT 1
SELECT code, name, symbol FROM currencies WHERE code = 'EUR' LIMIT 1
SELECT i.id, i.amount_cents, i.status FROM invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = $1 AND i.id = 1001 LIMIT 1
SELECT status, count(*) AS n, sum(total_cents) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY status ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, count(*) AS orders, avg(total_cents)::bigint AS avg_cents FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status IN ('paid', 'shipped') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 90
SELECT country, plan, count(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country, plan HAVING count(*) > 5 ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT method, count(*) AS n, round(avg(amount_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS avg_amount FROM payments WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY method ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.name, count(o.id) AS orders, coalesce(sum(o.total_cents), 0) AS revenue FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.tenant_id = $1 WHERE c.tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT o.id, o.status, i.amount_cents, p.method, p.card_last4 FROM orders o JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.tenant_id = $1 JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id AND p.tenant_id = $1 WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 AND o.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT oi.product_sku, sum(oi.quantity) AS units, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents) AS net_cents FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.tenant_id = $1 WHERE oi.tenant_id = $1 AND o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY oi.product_sku ORDER BY net_cents DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT o.currency, cur.symbol, sum(o.total_cents) AS total FROM orders o JOIN currencies cur ON cur.code = o.currency WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY o.currency, cur.symbol ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

WITH monthly AS (SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', created_at) AS month, sum(total_cents) AS spend FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT customer_id, month, spend, lag(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_spend, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY spend DESC) AS month_rank FROM monthly ORDER BY month DESC, month_rank LIMIT 200

WITH paid AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount_cents, i.paid_at - i.issued_at AS delay FROM invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = $1 AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL), stats AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n, avg(amount_cents) AS avg_cents, max(delay) AS worst_delay FROM paid GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name, s.n, s.avg_cents, s.worst_delay FROM stats s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = $1 WHERE s.n >= 3 ORDER BY s.worst_delay DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT id, total_cents, sum(total_cents) OVER (ORDER BY created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY total_cents DESC) AS rn FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND created_at >= date_trunc('year', now()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 500

SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.tenant_id = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 AND o.customer_id = c.id AND o.total_cents > (SELECT avg(o2.total_cents) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.tenant_id = $1)) ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 100

WITH orders_30d AS (SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_cents, o.currency, o.created_at FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 AND o.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'), items AS (SELECT oi.order_id, sum(oi.quantity) AS units, sum(oi.discount_cents) AS discounts FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY oi.order_id), inv AS (SELECT i.order_id, max(i.status) AS inv_status, max(i.paid_at) AS paid_at FROM invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT c.country, c.plan, count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers, count(o.id) AS orders, sum(it.units) AS units, sum(o.total_cents * coalesce(er.rate, 1)) AS revenue_usd, sum(it.discounts) AS discounts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE inv.paid_at IS NULL) AS unpaid, CASE WHEN count(o.id) > 100 THEN 'high' WHEN count(o.id) > 10 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS volume FROM orders_30d o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = $1 LEFT JOIN items it ON it.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er ON er.base = o.currency AND er.quote = 'USD' GROUP BY c.country, c.plan ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT 'orders' AS kind, count(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'invoices', count(*) FROM invoices WHERE tenant_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'payments', count(*) FROM payments WHERE tenant_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', count(*) FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'users', count(*) FROM users WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 10

WITH cohort AS (SELECT c.id AS customer_id, date_trunc('month', c.created_at) AS cohort_month FROM customers c WHERE c.tenant_id = $1), activity AS (SELECT o.customer_id, date_trunc('month', o.created_at) AS active_month FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT co.cohort_month, (EXTRACT(year FROM a.active_month) - EXTRACT(year FROM co.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM a.active_month) - EXTRACT(month FROM co.cohort_month) AS month_offset, count(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS active, round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.customer_id) / NULLIF(max(count(DISTINCT co.customer_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY co.cohort_month), 0), 1) AS retention_pct FROM cohort co LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.customer_id = co.customer_id GROUP BY co.cohort_month, a.active_month ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 500

SELECT u.display_name, u.role, ae.action, count(*) AS events, max(ae.created_at) AS last_seen, string_agg(DISTINCT ae.target, ', ' ORDER BY ae.target) AS targets FROM audit_events ae JOIN users u ON u.id = ae.actor_id AND u.tenant_id = $1 WHERE ae.tenant_id = $1 AND ae.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days' AND ae.action IN (SELECT DISTINCT a2.action FROM audit_events a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = $1 AND a2.created_at >= now() - interval '1 day') GROUP BY u.display_name, u.role, ae.action ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100
